checks.check: Measure battery output voltage at an accessible main output connector
checks.expected: 48 V nominal system; exact observed voltage must be recorded, not assumed

checks.check: Measure voltage at controller battery input
checks.expected: Should correspond to battery output if wiring and main connection are intact
No loose, recessed, oxidized or heat-damaged contacts
No visible damage, pinched sections or intermittent connection at bends/entries
Record measured supply and pinout source before concluding display failure

checks.check: Investigate controller after upstream supply path is verified
checks.expected: Controller diagnosis requires measured evidence; do not replace solely from symptom

safety: Do not short wires to force startup.
Do not open the lithium battery pack merely for this checklist.
Qualified personnel should handle high-current battery systems.
